title: Color Me Back!
type: chapter implementation specification, not compiled gameplay

stage_specs.name: Bouncing Berry Parade
stage_specs.objective: avoid telegraphed soft berry landing circles and interact with exposed crystal
stage_specs.on_miss: bounce safely to checkpoint and slow telegraphs after three misses

stage_specs.name: Mirror Berry Puzzle
stage_specs.objective: turn mirrors to route visible white beam to gem 2
stage_specs.on_miss: unlimited trial; optional solve hint; never randomized into unsolvable layout

stage_specs.name: Friendly Dragon Dance
stage_specs.objective: follow icon-marked slow stomps; climb safe platform, brush final crystal
stage_specs.on_miss: retry on next cycle, no progress lost

stage_specs.name: Cloudy Bubble Matching
stage_specs.objective: ride current and brush matching shell-symbol bubble

stage_specs.name: Waterway Maze
stage_specs.objective: rotate water-switch wheels to lead flow to spell bubble
stage_specs.on_miss: undo freely or replay route; no countdown

stage_specs.name: Ride the Giant Wave
stage_specs.objective: use wave lift and assisted bubble ride to reach final bubble
stage_specs.on_miss: respawn at wave start retaining prior stages

stage_specs.name: First Glimmer
stage_specs.objective: rotate first mirror to target sunflower receiver

stage_specs.name: Dancing Reflections
stage_specs.on_miss: restart beam at first mirror only

stage_specs.name: Wake-Up Melody
stage_specs.objective: repeat sun/flower/star symbols, then aim final reflector
stage_specs.on_miss: replay visual sequence and keep earlier progress

progress_storage: localStorage for starter; robust versioned migration needed for release
failure_policy: nonviolent, no lost lives; each stage has safe retries, checkpoints, optional hints
